# Award Watch

> Where federal money goes, organized by the organizations that receive it:
> the tender notices open on CanadaBuys and the award notices that follow,
> PSPC's contract history, every contract over $10,000 and every grant and
> contribution agreement federal departments publish, and the lobbying
> communications those organizations report. Updated nightly from the
> Government of Canada's open data. In English and French (?lang=fr).
> https://awardwatch.ca

## Bulk data: read these instead of crawling the profile and notice pages

Everything the pages show comes from these files and the government's own
open-data files, refreshed every night.

- https://awardwatch.ca/downloads/open-tenders.csv: every open tender notice, list fields
- https://awardwatch.ca/downloads/awards-YYYY.csv: the award notices of one calendar year of award
- https://awardwatch.ca/downloads/history-YYYY.csv: PSPC contract history of one calendar year of award
- https://awardwatch.ca/downloads/organizations.csv: one row per organization, with counts and totals per source
- https://awardwatch.ca/downloads/buyers.csv: one row per federal buyer, with counts and totals per source
- https://awardwatch.ca/data: the source files the site reads, when each was last read, and the licence

Downloads are limited to ten per minute per address.

## Pages worth reading

- https://awardwatch.ca/methodology: how organizations and buyers are merged and how money is counted, source by source
- https://awardwatch.ca/tenders: the open tender notices
- https://awardwatch.ca/organizations: every organization A to Z by province
- https://awardwatch.ca/corrections: how to report an error

## Terms

The records are reproduced under the Open Government Licence, Canada. Figures
the site computes are derived from those records, each source counted on its
own and never added to another. A record is a record, never a finding about
an organization.
